cohort: The study included 51 patients with expectantly managed preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM).
finding: Cervical IL-6 levels correlated more strongly with neonatal CRP and PCT levels on the first day after delivery than with maternal serum markers, but showed no significant association with the PPROM-to-delivery interval.
gest_age: Preterm (implied by PPROM and preterm birth context)
